articles.title: Retatrutide Phase 3 Data Exceeds Expectations
articles.summary: New triple-agonist retatrutide shows up to 24% weight loss in 48-week trials, surpassing tirzepatide and semaglutide.

articles.title: FDA Approves New Oral GLP-1 Formulation
articles.summary: The FDA has approved a novel oral formulation of semaglutide with improved bioavailability, making injections optional for some patients.

articles.title: BPC-157 Shows Promise in Traumatic Brain Injury Study
articles.summary: Preclinical study finds BPC-157 may reduce neuroinflammation and promote recovery after TBI, opening new therapeutic avenues.

articles.title: NAD+ Precursors Enter Phase 2 Longevity Trials
articles.summary: Largest-ever clinical trial on NAD+ precursors begins, testing whether boosting NAD+ can slow biological aging markers.

articles.title: MOTS-C Linked to Improved Insulin Sensitivity
articles.summary: Mitochondrial peptide MOTS-C found to significantly improve insulin sensitivity in metabolic syndrome patients.

articles.title: GHK-Cu Topical Formulation Gets Patent for Hair Growth
articles.summary: New patented copper peptide formulation shows 40% increase in hair density over 6 months in clinical testing.

articles.title: Semax & Selank: Russian Cognitive Peptides Gain Global Interest
articles.summary: Western research institutions begin large-scale studies on nootropic peptides Semax and Selank for anxiety and cognitive enhancement.

articles.title: Regulatory Crackdown on Unlicensed Peptide Vendors
articles.summary: Multiple countries issue warnings against unlicensed peptide sellers. Experts urge users to verify COAs and sourcing transparency.
